tools.description: [locus:cmp] REQUIRED before infrastructure work when pin is unclear. Returns active pin: tenant, binding, providers, frozen scopes. Never secrets. If unpinned, ask human to pin — you cannot.
tools.name: locus_whoami

tools.description: [locus:cmp] Single best next human/agent action for identity safety (enter, re-pin, approve, doctor fix, or ready). Call when stuck, unpinned, blocked, or unsure what to do. Never secrets.
tools.name: locus_safe_next

tools.description: [locus:cmp] Short pin status: pinned|unpinned, binding alias, tenant, seal ok, frozen. Prefer locus_whoami or locus_safe_next for decisions.
tools.name: locus_status

tools.description: [locus:cmp] Identity heartbeat: runtime drift / doctor-lite (seal, freeze, binding match). Safe for agents — never secrets. Call when pin health is unclear or tools fail with freeze/seal errors.
tools.name: locus_heartbeat

tools.description: [locus:cmp] Shell command for the HUMAN to enter/pin a binding. AGENTS CANNOT PIN — surface this command to the operator; do not claim you switched accounts.

alias.description: Optional binding alias (e.g. acme). When omitted, returns generic `locus enter`.

tools.name: locus_enter_hint

tools.description: [locus:cmp] List configured binding aliases and tenants (no secrets). Use to discover which alias to request via locus_request_pin.
tools.name: locus_list_bindings

tools.description: [locus:cmp] Request the HUMAN to pin a binding. AGENTS CANNOT PIN — records a request and returns the exact shell command. Pass alias from locus_list_bindings.
tools.name: locus_request_pin

tools.description: [locus:cmp] Verification plane (M5): score a free-text claim before acting. Returns {claim, confidence: unknown|low|medium|high, needs_tool, suggestion, signals, grounding?}. Heuristic — numbers/URLs/versions/currency ($)/percentages/absolute language (always|never) ⇒ needs_tool + low confidence; identity claims ground against whoami when pinned. Suggestion names concrete next steps (provider reads, locus exec, whoami). Never secrets. For hub session pack use locus_verify_session (or CLI: locus verify session --json).

text.description: Claim to score (factual assertion before acting)

tools.name: locus_verify_claim

tools.description: [locus:cmp] Verification plane (M5): hub session pack — same JSON as `locus verify session --json`. Returns {kind:"session", version, whoami?, doctor, safe_next, session_ok}. Available unpinned. Gate on session_ok (isError only on hard store failures). Never secrets — aliases, verdicts, scopes only.
tools.name: locus_verify_session

tools.description: [locus:cmp] Providers and frozen scopes for the active pin only. Frozen project_ref/team_id/orgs cannot be overridden by tool args.
tools.name: locus_providers

tools.description: [locus:cmp] Frozen Supabase scope for tenant `cmp-co` binding `cmp`: project_ref=proj_cmp, read_only=true. Identity only — no SQL. project_ref is frozen on every tool.

project_ref.description: Ignored if binding freezes project_ref; mismatch is denied.

tools.name: supabase.scope

tools.description: [locus:cmp] Return the frozen Supabase project_ref for this pin (proj_cmp). Agents must not invent another ref.

project_ref.description: Ignored if binding freezes project_ref; mismatch is denied.

tools.name: supabase.project_ref

tools.description: [locus:cmp] Frozen Vercel scope for tenant `cmp-co`: team_id=team_cmp, projects=[], env=[<any>]. team_id and env target are frozen.

env.description: Env target (production|preview|development). Denied if outside binding scope.env allowlist.

team_id.description: Ignored if binding freezes team_id; mismatch is denied.

tools.name: vercel.scope

tools.description: [locus:cmp] SYNTHETIC prod deploy stub — policy-gated. Frozen team_id=team_cmp, env=[<any>]. Does not deploy in phase 1. [requires human approval under current pin]

env.description: Env target; denied if outside binding scope.env allowlist.

team_id.description: Ignored if binding freezes team_id; mismatch is denied.

tools.name: vercel.deploy.prod
